title: Alert
description: An alert at any of the three tiers (docs/alert-system.md). 2a and 2b are created already 'sent'; 2c is created 'pending' and only reaches the driver once an engineer approves it.

tier.description: 2a preventative rule, 2b signal pattern, 2c anomaly requiring approval.

message.description: Driver-facing text, spoken by TTS on arrival. Short imperative sentences.

status.description: pending is 2c only, awaiting the engineer.

rule_id.description: For 2a/2b, which configured rule or pattern fired.

sigma.description: 2c only: peak deviation that triggered detection.

recommendation.description: 2c only: Gemma's proposed driver message, editable by the engineer before approval.
